findings.claim: retry() assigns a brand-new task_id via uuid4 instead of reusing the original id, violating the retry-semantics invariant that downstream consumers rely on for deduplication.
findings.failure_scenario: A FAILED task with task_id 'abc123' is retried; task.task_id becomes a fresh uuid (e.g. 'f47ac10b-...'), so a downstream consumer that dedupes on task_id no longer recognizes the retried attempt as the same task and processes it as a distinct one, breaking dedupe/tracking for that task.
